rules: Use ReDMCSB source-locks as the primary functional template for DM1 and CSB gameplay, UI state machines, save/load fields, timers, input routing, and compatibility quirks.
Use Firestaff runtime probes to prove the clean-room implementation follows the ReDMCSB-derived contract without importing ReDMCSB code.
Use original DOSBox captures only to promote visual, pixel, content, audio-cadence, or same-state parity rows.
Do not promote a screenshot or pixel row to MATCHED from ReDMCSB source evidence alone.

currentBlockers.nextAction: Keep the live stock-original DOSBox-debug probe on the surface backend and narrow the first missing F0359/C080 boundary after mapped macOS route input. The accepted pass162 address-gate order remains F0359 22F4:030D -> F0380 22F4:0699 -> F0377 1E44:02FE -> F0275 1859:1405 as the static-F0372 proxy -> F0280 1782:0031. The tmux/pass247 BP acceptance probe did not confirm debugger-prompt command parsing on the DOSBox-X symlink, but the owned-PTY DOSBox-X -debug/-break-start probe accepted all pass162 BP/BPM commands. The surface-backend live HoC probe, movement-click control, movement double-click control, autolock control, keyboard-capture control, external cliclick control, System Events control, and direct postToPid control all record FIRES startup, DATA\DUNGEON.DAT load, 34 stock-original memory-breakpoint stops, route_window_found=true, route_control_ok=true, and no C080-chain code stops. The movement controls also post explicit mouseMoved events before down/up and log pre-move=true, and the movement-click control warps the macOS cursor to the mapped SDL point with cursor-warp=true, but still misses F0359. The double-click control shows the first click is not merely being consumed by focus/capture. The autolock control uses DOSBox-X autolock=true, mouse_emulation=always, clip_mouse_button=none, and mouse=debug logging, but also misses F0359. Its dosbox_runtime.log proves MOUSE/INT33 initialization and reset, but contains no route-click motion/button log entries. The keyboard-capture control emits key ctrl-f10 before the same route clicks and still produces no DOSBox-X motion/button log rows. The external cliclick control replaces the Swift/CGEvent mouse-posting path with /opt/homebrew/bin/cliclick while keeping cursor warp and the same DOSBox-X mouse settings, but it still stops before F0359 and records no route-click motion/button log rows. The System Events control replaces both direct CGEvent and cliclick mouse posting with /usr/bin/osascript Accessibility clicking, proves the clicks targeted the DOSBox-X FIRES window successfully, but still stops before F0359 and records no route-click motion/button log rows. The direct postToPid control posts CGEvent mouse move/down/up to the DOSBox process PID, proves the mapped clicks returned success, but still stops before F0359 and records no route-click motion/button log rows. The OpenGL-output control is not comparable F0359 evidence because it did not prove BP/BPM retention, FIRES/DUNGEON readiness, or a route-window click; keep it as a separate output-backend harness/readiness blocker. The generated pass162 address-gate manifest now includes dosbox_mouse_log_summary for each live probe; the surface-backed autolock, keyboard-capture, cliclick, System Events, and direct postToPid controls all have existing logs and route_motion_button_line_count=0. Treat the next pass as DOSBox-X SDL/Cocoa event-ingestion or debugger event-pump work on the proven surface harness, not more HoC coordinate guessing or another six-shot overlay route.
